author: PoliceHelicopter
body:
I'm tourney banned while I haven't even scrimmed with my team, how can I be held responsible for my team not showing up?
I'm forum banned for ADVISING a server to a certain player. I made a small mistake but I did not deserve a permanent forum ban.

A few days ago I played this megascrimm thing cause I was on the same server as the people organising it. I was invited by some guys to join again today, however since I was forum banned I could not make a team. So I decided to go on my alt and play like that, since I'm not permabanned that shouldn't be against the rules right?
Anyways, I played like 1 scrim and left after that because I was bored, and today I try to log in on my main and I'm permanently banned for tourney ban evasion.

tl;dr I'm an OCN player who was seriously considering moving to Avicus after OCN shuts down, but I simply can't cause I got (imo) wrongly forum, tourney, and permabanned.

Now before you forum ban me a second time, think about what I said. I don't think I deserve a perma ban. You're banning a potentially new regular because he tried to scrimm with the rest of the community.

title: Honestly...

replies.author: Tazz
replies.body:
If you want to talk about your tournament ban appeal to officials@avicus.net.

Your forum ban runs out in like a month, and I won't get you forum banned because you are simply appealing an infraction, just don't post on the public forums.

Now on to ban evasion - you were banned for ban evasion because as you are tournament banned you can not create a team. You then went on an alt to create a team which is where ban evading came from.

If you would like the officials could have a discussion about your permanent ban for ban evading because you only ban evaded a tournament ban so it's a bit unfair.

replies.author: Tazz
replies.body:
Hello Samwellys, 

After discussing with the other officials, we have decided to appeal your bans for Ban Evasion. However, do not do this again because a post will soon be made regarding blacklists. 

Do not evade your forum ban anymore and do not create a team. If you want to appeal your tournament ban email officials@avicus.net.

Refer to this thread for more information on blacklists: https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/346a3256c

Regards

Tazz and the Official Team
